

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().build().unwrap();




rt.block_on(async {




let (tx_a, mut rx_a) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>(1);




let (tx_b, mut rx_b) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>(1);




let (tx_c, mut rx_c) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>(1);




let payload = String::from("selected payload");





tokio::select! {
biased;

    


_ = async {
    (rx_a).recv().await


}
 => {

},



    


_ = async {
    (rx_b).recv().await


}
 => {

    

print!("received b");




},



    


_ = async {
    (tx_c).send(payload).await


}
 => {

    

print!("sent c");




},



}





drop((tx_a, tx_b, rx_c));




});



    
}
